post.title: Your biggest enemy has your face. 🪞
post.description: Send this to someone who keeps getting in their own way.
post.pinned_comment: What does your inner voice tell you most? 👇

scenes.narration: Your biggest enemy is not out there. It wakes up when you wake up, and it has your face.
It is the voice that says, start tomorrow. You are not ready. Who do you think you are?
It knows every fear you have ever had, because it was there when you learned them.
It doesn't fight you openly. It just makes you comfortable, one small excuse at a time.
Every great person you know heard that same voice. The difference is, they stopped obeying it.
You don't have to destroy it. You only have to stop letting it make your decisions.
Do the thing while it is still talking. Do it scared. Do it badly. Just do it.
And slowly, the person in the mirror will start to look different.
Not because the world changed, but because you finally did.
Win the war inside, and the war outside becomes easy.
So who wins today? You, or the voice?
